amendments.cause: the Fisher exact implementation in this namespace's runner inherited the frozen cohort runner's denominator comb(2n, n); Fisher's exact test conditions on the successes margin, so the correct denominator is comb(2n, total_successes). Discovered during report verification by an independent fraction-arithmetic cross-check against scipy.stats.fisher_exact: the defective formula's two-sided value equals the correct one scaled by comb(2n,T)/comb(2n,n) (numerator selection was already correct); the one-sided values disagree likewise.

amendments.impact: none on session outcomes, terminal states, acceptance counts, error classes, query counts, tokens, cost, or gate results — only the summary-level test statistics changed. Falsifier verdicts are UNCHANGED: F-primary rule = (two-sided p >= 0.05 AND arm A turn-2 submissions = 0); corrected two-sided p = 0.6499 >= 0.05 but turn-2 submissions = 3, so F-primary remains FALSE. F-secondary and F3 unaffected (no test statistic).
amendments.lineage_disclosure: the SAME defect is present in the frozen cohort H2-CBC-AGENCY-20261023-v1: its REPORT.md section 3 publishes the one-sided 4v4 p-value as 6/70 = 0.0857; the correct Fisher exact one-sided (A>B) value for [[4,0],[2,2]] is 6/28 = 0.214286 (scipy-verified). The frozen namespace is read-only and was NOT modified; its record stands as published with this correction noted here and in this namespace's REPORT.md.
